body:
Someone asked me why in a direct message for some context on the skins.

One problem skins is solving is we want to have a skeleton with associated skinned base meshes and another skeleton containing non-base meshes. We want to transfer the "non-base" meshes skeleton onto the "base" mesh skeleton.

The meshes only store the skin index which maps the vertex bone influence index to the skeleton joint name.

Provide a skeleton with the mesh and the mapping is kept.
